resources.string: Taimaka wajen tallafa wa wannan na’ura
Ba a gwada OpenPressure da wannan na’urar auna hawan jini ba tukuna. Rahoton na’ura yana nuna yadda take sadarwa kuma zai iya taimakawa wajen buɗe ƙarin fasaloli gare ta a cikin manhajar.

Ba a gwada OpenPressure da wannan na’urar auna hawan jini ba tukuna. Zai taimaka sosai idan ka raba rahoton na’ura a cikin GitHub issue. Rahotonka da taimakonka za su iya buɗe ƙarin fasaloli don na’urarka a cikin manhajar.\n\nRahoton yana ƙunshe da bayanan fasaha kawai. Ba ya taɓa haɗa da sakamakon awo, lokutan awo, sunaye, adireshin Bluetooth ko lambar serial. Za ka iya duba shi kafin ka raba komai.
Duba rahoton da ke ƙasa. “%1$s” yana kwafe shi kuma ya buɗe fom ɗin issue da aka shirya; liƙa rahoton a can. Ba a aika komai ta atomatik.
An kwafe rahoton. Liƙa shi cikin GitHub issue.
Ba a sami burauza ba. Ajiye rahoton ka buɗe %1$s.
Ba a iya ajiye rahoton na’ura ba.
